title: Accelerate composite Dedekind BL replay
objective: Profile and generically accelerate composite Dedekind Buchmann-Lenstra construction and exact replay for T8 and corpus controls using source-transparent ordinary-Python kernels

handoff.summary: Adds a packed source-transparent exact-integer row-HNF kernel and routes composite Dedekind construction plus certificate replay through it. CPython and disabled/unavailable native execution retain the same-source ordinary-Python fallback. The focused T8/corpus differential and corruption test passes, strict CPython/Ruff/Pyright validation passes, and a three-sample benchmark measures the compiled packed HNF 4.3--5.3x faster than list-based Sage.js HNF across T8 and five controls.
risks: The broad pnpm test:native run was stopped during its build stage at coordinator request; integration must run the coherent native suite.
A clean production build will use the correct dynamic fallback until the new source is registered in architecture/native-kernels.json.
next_steps: Register id buchmann-lenstra-row-hnf-production, source src/lib/sagejs/number_fields/bl_composite_kernel.py, and function packed_row_hnf_in_place in architecture/native-kernels.json with benchmark bench/number-field-buchmann-lenstra-fast.cjs.
Run pnpm test:native after integration and verify test/production-native-kernels.cjs publishes and autoloads the registered kernel.
